correctness.rationale: For fixed p=|W∩A| and q=|W∩B|, the representation of a_i has x_i zeros, q-y_i ones, p-x_i twos, and y_i threes. Therefore two A-vertices collide exactly when their matched-pair membership bits coincide. This forces n<=4. At n=4, all four binary patterns occur and the 00 matched pair collides across the bipartition. At n=3, symbolic evaluation of all four possible three-pattern collections leaves exactly two, each with six distinct representations. The included checker independently verifies all vertex subsets for n=3 through 8.

value.rationale: Finiteness is a core structural question for multiset dimension. Crown graphs are a natural standard diameter-three regular bipartite family not decided by the foundational generic obstructions.
